utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Culver City' by name among the cities in its service area.

value.name: Clean Power Alliance (CPA) - 100% Green Power (default)
value.notes: Confirmed via a directly-fetched California Community Choice Association (CalCCA) press release: Culver City is explicitly named among the communities on 100% Green Power as their default CPA energy option. Customers may choose another CPA option or opt out at any time.

county.notes: Culver City is a well-documented Los Angeles County city; also listed under Los Angeles County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of Culver City Building Safety Division

permit_url.notes: Directly re-verified via browser this session (an earlier HTTP 403 to automated WebFetch was intermittent, not a persistent block).

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Culver City/Los Angeles County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

required_documents.notes: The Electrical Permit Application is required only for the alternative (non-Symbium) submittal path for projects outside or disqualified from the automated platform.

value.notes: The City's own page states the Symbium partnership provides 'instant Solar & ESS Permits' and that 'your permit will be issued automatically, without manual review or an in-person visit,' with 'Permits...issued in real time when you apply on Symbium and after the City permit fees are paid.'
